prompts.day:
Generate a fresh clean photorealistic 9:16 environment reference matching image1's scene and camera precisely. Image1 is scene geometry/material reference, image2 is Xiaoxing CHARACTER identity ONLY INSIDE a framed photograph. Preserve every scene feature and object placement of image1; change the CONTENT INSIDE the framed wall photo as specified below. Fresh high-quality rendering, no patch overlay textures.

PHOTO CONTENT, essential new direction: a joyful spontaneous smartphone FRONT-CAMERA GROUP SELFIE taken by Xiaoxing herself. NOT a formal arranged group portrait. Inside the existing wooden frame, Xiaoxing's adorable big happy face fills roughly the lower-center/left 40 percent of the photograph, much closer to the lens than the others, with cream/apricot fluffy fur, big amber eyes, curled forelock, green sprout bib and soft tilted halo/tiny star as in image2. Happy bright eyes and natural cute open-mouth feline smile, no human teeth. Her foreshortened furry foreleg extends toward the lower edge of the photo as if holding the phone just outside the captured image. The phone itself is the camera and need not be visible. Behind her MANY cats of varied coats cram together exuberantly to get in shot: faces peeking over shoulders, noses leaning forward, some standing on tiptoe, some partially cut off at photo edges, asymmetrical overlapping happy crowd, spontaneous affectionate chaos. Slight selfie wide-angle ONLY inside the photograph; main room lens remains rectilinear. The result should read instantly as 'she took a fun selfie with her cat friends', not someone else photographing a cat holding a phone, not a mirror selfie. NO neat rows, NO solemn school portrait, NO map. Cats exist ONLY in framed photo, actual room empty.

SCENE LOCK: outside window looking squarely inward. Thick complete wooden arch with continuous two vertical jambs and horizontal outer sill at nearest plane, vines/daisies on exterior frame, narrow plaster outside. ALL indoor items behind frame. Right jamb MUST OCCLUDE banker lamp/desk/tray outer edges; left jamb OCCLUDES indoor plant/books/cabinet. Sill hides desk front. No indoor object crosses in front of posts. No glass/bars. Typewriter rear centered low on green mat, keyboard faces away into room, short blank paper. Lamp/mug/tray on RIGHT, plant/books LEFT. Keep left cabinet/low sideboard partly hidden along LEFT receding wall, then outward-opening right-hinged doorway along same left wall, and far-left corner to right of whole door. Far frontal wall only photo+3hooks, continuous flat to RIGHT beyond jamb, no right corner fold. All far wall horizontal trim, photo frame, desk and sill level; verticals straight, camera no yaw/roll/pitch. Same rug, walnut sage brass, flowers and light locations. DAYTIME warm light through door/window and warm lamps. No actual cats, no grid/warping/text/watermarks.
